title: Café online menu
summary: A mobile-friendly menu that the owner updates in minutes.
description: Sample project. QR-code menu with categories, prices and daily specials, plus an admin page for staff to edit items without a developer.

title: Gym class booking
summary: Members book classes and see availability in real time.
description: Sample project. Class timetable, member sign-in, booking limits per class and a dashboard for trainers to view attendance.

title: Supermarket catalogue
summary: A searchable product catalogue with weekly offers.
description: Sample project. Products by category, stock status, offer banners and an order-by-phone or WhatsApp button for local customers.

title: Salon appointments
summary: Clients pick a service, stylist and time slot online.
description: Sample project. Service list with durations, stylist calendars, automatic slot blocking and an admin view of the day's appointments.

title: Restaurant ordering
summary: Online ordering for pickup and delivery with a kitchen dashboard.
description: Sample project. Cart, checkout, order status updates and a live dashboard where the kitchen accepts and completes orders.
